$comment: setkernel org version holds: the one source. Each hold keeps every setkernel repo below a version until Raghav has tested it. Edit here (Raghav's approval), run bin/generate, merge; the plugin shows the change in every Claude session and hq's version-policy workflow brings each repo's .github/dependabot.yml in line. Repo-specific pins stay in that repo's own config. Dependabot ignore entries use each ecosystem's version syntax; bin/dependabot-policy only evaluates '>=X.Y.Z' forms when matching open PRs.

holds.rule: Node 24 everywhere: .nvmrc, package.json engines.node, actions/setup-node node-version, Docker node images, the runner image, and @types/node 24.x.
holds.why: 24 is the Active LTS. Node 26 becomes LTS on 2026-10-28 (github.com/nodejs/Release schedule.json).
holds.lift: Raghav has tested Node 26 after it is LTS.

holds.rule: typescript 6.0.x in every package.json and lockfile; no TypeScript 7 or 6.1, including through tools that bundle it.
holds.why: Peer ranges on 2026-10-13 reject 7.0: svelte-check 4.7.6 (^5 || ^6), @sveltejs/kit 3.0.1 (^6.0.0), svelte2tsx 0.7.61 (^6), @astrojs/check 0.9.10 (^5 || ^6); typescript-eslint 8.71.2 accepts only <6.1.0.
holds.lift: Those peer ranges include the new version and Raghav has tested it.

holds.rule: squizlabs/php_codesniffer 3.x wherever WordPress Coding Standards (WPCS) is used.
holds.why: WPCS 3.4.1 (2026-07-27) requires squizlabs/php_codesniffer ^3.13.5; PHPCS 4.0.4 is out.
holds.lift: A WPCS release supports PHPCS 4 and Raghav has tested it.
